Today, Software Freedom Conservancy publishes [Recommendations When Using LLM-backed Generative AI systems for FOSS Contributions](https://sfconservancy.org/llm-gen-ai/llm-backed-generative-ai-recommendations.html) . SFC's Copyleft and Software Right to Repair Team co-drafted these policy recommendations in collaboration with a team of volunteers from the Free Software community. These recommendations include substantial feedback that SFC received in its ongoing public sessions and meetings with SFC member projects.

The recommendations reflect the extremely difficult dilemmas that these systems pose for FOSS contributors. SFC and its volunteers understand that FOSS developers are approaching LLM-gen-AI from a variety of perspectives. The recommendations offer practical assistance to minimize the damage caused by using proprietary systems, whether FOSS contributors reject LLM-gen-AI or choose (voluntarily or by employer mandate) to use them.

These recommendations are best practices (but not definitions or requirements) that SFC and its volunteers

formulated after careful study of the growing LLM-gen-AI use among FOSS contributors. SFC will follow these recommendations with a [series of supporting materials](https://sfconservancy.org/llm-gen-ai), including documents, online tutorials, public Q&As, [podcasts](https://sfconservancy.org/casts/the-corresponding-source/), and other community engagement. We will routinely refine our recommendations and continue to support FOSS contributors as they navigate this difficult landscape.

# SFC 發布 FOSS 貢獻者使用 LLM 生成式 AI 的建議
Software Freedom Conservancy（SFC）今日發布[《FOSS 貢獻者使用 LLM 支援的生成式 AI 系統時的建議》](https://sfconservancy.org/llm-gen-ai/llm-backed-generative-ai-recommendations.html)。SFC 的 Copyleft 與軟體維修權團隊，與自由軟體社群的一組志工合作，共同起草了這份政策建議。這些建議也納入了 SFC 在持續舉辦的公開場次，以及與 SFC 會員專案會議中收到的大量回饋。
這些建議反映出，這類系統對 FOSS 貢獻者造成的極其困難的兩難處境。SFC 與志工們理解，FOSS 開發者是從各種不同角度看待 LLM 生成式 AI（LLM-gen-AI）。無論 FOSS 貢獻者拒絕 LLM 生成式 AI，或選擇使用它們（不論是自願，或因雇主要求），這份建議都提供實務協助，以盡量降低使用專有系統所造成的傷害。
這些建議是最佳實務，但不是定義或要求；它們是 SFC 與志工們在仔細研究 FOSS 貢獻者日益增加的 LLM 生成式 AI 使用情形後所制定。SFC 接下來會推出一[系列支援材料](https://sfconservancy.org/llm-gen-ai)，包括文件、線上教學、公開問答、[Podcast](https://sfconservancy.org/casts/the-corresponding-source/)，以及其他社群參與活動。SFC 將定期修訂這些建議，並持續支持 FOSS 貢獻者在這個困難局面中前進。
